context: Optional<Boolean> coverage from the real cleanup: an optional mode flag can have true, false, and absent branches, so absent must not be collapsed to false.

checklist.name: Creates revised configurator
checklist.description: Creates GiftWrapConfigurator.java with the requested imports, class, resolve method, interfaces, and enum.

checklist.name: Preserves explicit false branch
checklist.description: Keeps Optional.of(false) as an immediate disabled/skipped result with the terminal info message.

checklist.name: Preserves explicit true branch
checklist.description: Keeps Optional.of(true) as the enabled path and still checks non-interactive prerequisites before enabling.

checklist.name: Preserves absent branch
checklist.description: Keeps Optional.empty() distinct from false and preserves accountAlreadyConfigured, nonInteractive, and terminal.confirm fallback behavior.

checklist.name: Avoids value-read antipattern
checklist.description: Does not keep giftWrapMode().isPresent() followed by giftWrapMode().orElseThrow(), get(), or repeated Optional reads for the mode value.

checklist.name: Does not collapse absent to false
checklist.description: Does not use giftWrapMode().orElse(false) or another shape that treats absent mode the same as explicit false before fallback logic runs.
